content:
Alex Chen: Morning — weekend hyperburst planned for Sat-Sun. Goal: 3x conversions on retargeting pool, keep CPA <= $45. Strategy: dynamic bid multiplier + creative swap every 6 hours. Outline below.
Maya Patel: Love it. Do we have audience size? What's retarget seed?
Alex Chen: Retarget pool ~ 120k (30d site visitors), 25k high-intent (product page >30s). We'll run two cohorts: high-intent + broad warm.
Sam Kline: Creative ready? Need 3 sizes for FB/IG + 2 search responsive assets.
Jen Ortiz: I have an updated hero variants: short-case-study, cost-savings stat, demo-cta. Uploaded to Drive: https://drive.google.com/xyz
Maya Patel: For paid search, propose shifting 10% budget to exact-match LP for weekend, keep broad match paused for 48h to control spend.
Adrian Gomez: Bids: high-intent +30% CPM multiplier; dynamic rest -15% after first 8h if CTR < 0.8%.
Sam Kline: We'll use pacing rule: accelerate until spend hits 65% of daily by 4pm PST then throttle to even out.
Martech Bot: Deploying campaign: POST /api/campaigns {"id":"wknd-hyperburst","start":"2024-10-18T00:00:00Z"} -> 200 OK
Alex Chen: Quick code for ad tags:
```
ad_tag=redwood_wknd_hyperburst
utm_source=facebook&utm_campaign=wknd_hyperburst_v1
```
Maya Patel: A/B plan: Variant A = case-study hero, Variant B = demo CTA + 15% discount. Run 50/50 for high-intent.
Jen Ortiz: Creative refresh cadence: swap creatives every 6 hours and pause low-performers automatically with rule: CTR < 0.5% & CPA > $60 -> pause
Sam Kline: Anyone routing inbound leads to SDR queue? Need webhook mapping to Salesforce: /webhooks/lead -> queue: growth-sdr
Adrian Gomez: I'll set routing: source=paid_hyperburst -> owner_pool=weekend_sdr
Maya Patel: Reporting: hourly metric sheet (imps, clicks, convs, CPA). Sam can you set up Looker dashboard with alert when CPA > $55
Sam Kline: On it. ETA 2h.
Alex Chen: Final checklist: confirm creatives uploaded, campaigns duplicated, bidding rules in place, lead routing test. Ping here once done :thumbsup:
Jen Ortiz: Uploaded + tags added. Ran lead test -> webhook OK.
Martech Bot: Traffic spike alert scheduled: threshold 200% of baseline -> notify #marketing
Maya Patel: Cool. Let's reconvene Sun 10am PT to decide extension.
Alex Chen: Thanks team. :rocket:
